title: Kissed Roast Kenyan Narutomaki Roast
description: A midnight-craving Kenyan dish featuring narutomaki, roast, and a hint of mustard, perfect for a low-sodium diet. This bouncy-qq dish is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef roast with salt-free seasoning, black pepper, garlic, and ginger.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound.
While the roast is cooking, slice the narutomaki into thin rounds.
In a small bowl, mix together the mustard and a pinch of black pepper.
After the roast has cooked for 30 minutes, brush the mustard mixture evenly over the top of the roast.
Return the roast to the oven and continue cooking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving with narutomaki and your choice of sides.
